newsitem.title: UK: Imperial up but dawn raid fails to appear.
newsitem.headline: Imperial up but dawn raid fails to appear.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Tobacco Plc leapt higher in active trading on Thursday, though traders said there was no sign of the dawn raid on the stock that was rumoured late yesterday.
Imperial shares were up 22p at 426 by 0750 GMT in volume of 1.8 million shares.
"The rumour of a dawn raid was circulating last night but we have not seen anything yet," said a market-maker at one brokerage.
Traders said Imperial's share price had been squeezed higher amid a shortage of stock in the market. The company was demerged from conglomerate Hanson Plc and began trading only on Tuesday.
